channel.title: Paksh: Science & Tech
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: AI tool predicts cancer survival from patient selfies, study finds
item.description: An artificial intelligence tool has been developed that can estimate a cancer patient's biological age and predict their chances of survival from a single photograph of their face, according to a study. The system was custom-built by… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Apple HomeView Smart Display May Feature Robotic Arm, Larger Screen
item.description: Apple's upcoming HomeView smart display is reportedly being developed with a 360-degree robotic arm and a 9-inch display. This potential new feature could significantly alter the functionality and user experience of smart home devices. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Orionid Meteor Shower Peaks, Offering Viewing Opportunities
item.description: The Orionid meteor shower is expected to peak, offering opportunities for skygazers to observe shooting stars. The event is associated with Halley's Comet. Information is available on when and how to best view the celestial display. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Japan launches historic mission to Mars' moon Phobos
item.description: Japan has launched the Martian Moons eXploration (MMX) mission, a historic endeavor aimed at exploring Mars' moon Phobos and returning samples to Earth by 2031. The mission's objective is to collect samples from Phobos and bring them back… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 3.

item.title: Astronomers Discover First Green Star
item.description: Astronomers have identified a green star, a dense stellar remnant known as a white dwarf. The star acquired its chartreuse hue after consuming rocky debris from planets that previously orbited it. The color of a star is typically… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: SpaceX's Starshield: A Military Version of Starlink
item.description: SpaceX has developed Starshield, a militarized version of its Starlink satellite internet service. While sharing underlying satellite technology with Starlink, Starshield is designed for secure communications and can also provide Earth… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 2.

item.title: Amazon launches AI wearables, scientists warn of AI-induced false memories
item.description: Amazon has introduced new AI-powered wearable devices designed to listen to conversations and retain information. Concurrently, scientists are raising concerns that artificial intelligence may contribute to the creation of false memories… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.description: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) has successfully tested a hack-free quantum communication system designed to protect sensitive military data. The test involved a Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) platform deployed in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Company Aims to Resurrect Extinct Dodo Using Gene Editing
item.description: Colossal Biosciences is reportedly working on a project to bring back the extinct dodo bird. The company plans to use gene-editing technology to introduce dodo traits into the cells of the Nicobar pigeon, which is the dodo's closest living… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.description: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) has developed a system named 'Kavach' designed to prevent enemy espionage and secure sensitive data. This development is presented as a significant achievement aimed at blocking… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: The Indian Council for Scientific Research (ISCR) and CHAKRA have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) aimed at enhancing clinical research capabilities within Maharashtra. The agreement focuses on strengthening the capacity for… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Google has launched its new flagship artificial intelligence model, Gemini 4 Argon. The AI model is designed for developers and businesses, with a stated focus on complex coding, cybersecurity, scientific research, robotics, and enterprise… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.description: Epic Games announced plans to develop a new Disney shooter game that will be "AI-only," meaning it will be built entirely using artificial intelligence. The company has delayed the game's development to incorporate this AI-only approach… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Indian scientist Dr. Tasleem Arif named among world's top 2% scientists
item.description: Dr. Tasleem Arif, principal of Nadaun college, has been recognized as one of the world's top 2% scientists for the third consecutive year. This recognition highlights his ongoing contributions to scientific research. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
